comparison.objective: Carry a hot iron over a shirt and park it soleplate-down on a heat-resistant rest, versus tang removal.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware transport, orientation, placement, and release, not force-regulated impact and fragment containment.
comparison.success_condition: Iron released soleplate-down on its rest without touching the shirt; exact contact and stability thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Thermal-hazard transport tests a different physical ability and end state.
